137.news_title: 29inch CRT Tube Replacement with the Arcooda 29inch 4x3 Arcade LCD Monitor
137.long_description: We have been working on a number of solutions for your 29inch CRT tube monitor replacement by using either our 27.5 or 29.3inch LCD 4x3 ratio arcade LCD monitors. As there is not one size fits all, we are releasing 2 different models, a 27.5inch and a 29.3inch 4x3 advanced panel for all your arcade and amusement machine needs. As with all our monitors, they will support native 15khz, 24khz, 31khz and up to 1600x1200 with RGB, VGA and HDMI input. There is a new control board under development which will use our existing firmware, and add extra functions suitable for advanced arcade and home users. Preorder will open in February, with delivery in May. For more information and to pre-order please visit; 29-3-inch-4-3-Ratio-Arcade-LCD-Monitor-15khz-24khz-31khz-up-to-1600x1200-20180 Please Note - when ordering, please take care to check the differences in the viewable sizes of our monitors, against the viewable size on your arcade machine (measure inside the bezel/exposed monitor). If you review the video that shows a Sega Blast City, we removed a 29inch Nanao CRT tube monitor, and whilst the Arcooda 29inch 4x3 monitor can be mounted, its not the perfect solution. For the Sega Blast City, please consider the 27.5inch which will offer the best mounting/viewing/size option.
